deps.edn.reason: Moved from kotoba-lang/kami-engine packages/ (JUN-649). The kotoba git floors and pins, and the kami packages that are bundled in this monorepo, become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice; sibling-checkout aliases for the old per-repository layout are removed. The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases stay removed: the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the paths.
